title: cirsium lanceolatum subsp. hypoleucum
intro: Cirsium lanceolatum subsp. hypoleucum, commonly known as the Hoary Plume or Hoary Thistle, is a plant species in the sunflower family, characterized by its tall stem, lance-shaped leaves, and feathery, plume-like inflorescence. The plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving digestive issues due to its antispasmodic and carminative properties. The therapeutic actions of Cirsium lanceolatum subsp. hypoleucum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, attributed to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. The bioactive constituents of this plant may also include sesquiterpenes and triterpenoids, which contribute to its potential health benefits and therapeutic uses.
